static_scan.interpretation: The final-letter callback writes DS:60D8, the 01D7 main-loop completion routine owns the all-seven comparator and presentation, and DS:85DB is the explicit handoff into the level-transition state machine.
static_scan.outer_state_gate: 01D7:4EA0 tests DS:89E6; its positive branch 01D7:4EAA calls the completion/effect consumer at 01D7:14E1. The normal cloud callback 01F7:9269 writes DS:89E6=0xFFFF when the player is in range.
static_scan.presentation_wait_helper: 0207:10A9 samples PIT channel 0 through ports 43h/40h, compares the sample with DS:97F4, retries while equal, and stores the changed sample at 0207:1113.

transition_gate_census.interpretation: The terminal value 0xFFFF is written only by the outer gameplay/completion branches; initialization and transition-loop paths clear the gate. The downstream resource path is therefore controlled by both the completion handoff and the transition-loop state, not by the final-letter callback alone.

post_4eaa_transition_closure.entry_guard: 01D7:4EA0 continues only when DS:89E6 != 0; zero returns through the ordinary 01D7:504F tail.
post_4eaa_transition_closure.wait_selection: 01D7:4EAA/4EDD sets a local delay to 0x014F. If byte DS:5044 is zero, the wait argument is replaced by 0x46; otherwise the full 0x014F delay is used. Both branches call the pending transition wait before the completion consumer.
post_4eaa_transition_closure.wait_state: DS:5044 is the audio-ready byte. The wait call is 01D7:4EDD/4EE6 -> 0207:0002; the timer wait clears DS:819E and yields until the IRQ sets it.
post_4eaa_transition_closure.completion_consumer: 01D7:4F0D calls 01D7:14E1. That routine formats the score/cereal card, tests DS:60D8 at 01D7:1670, and takes 01D7:16C6-1704 only for mask 0x007F.
post_4eaa_transition_closure.post_consumer_gate: When DS:85DB is zero, 01D7:4F10 maps the ordinary selector continuation. When nonzero, 01D7:4FAF copies DS:85D4 to DS:85D6 and maps 0/1, 3/4, 6/7, 9/10, and 0x0C/0x0D to selector states 0x10..0x14.
post_4eaa_transition_closure.reload_gate: 01D7:5010 enters the reload/re-entry calls only when DS:89E0 != 0xFFFF; the 01D7:504F tail dispatches progression when DS:89EC != 0 or DS:89E0 == 0xFFFF, otherwise it returns to the ordinary loop.
post_4eaa_transition_closure.static_interpretation: The missing post-4EAA behavior is a timed presentation/audio wait followed by the completion consumer. It is not an unresolved direct jump from the cloud branch. The semantic meaning of the local stack flags and the natural condition that permits the later reload branch remain address-qualified.
post_4eaa_transition_closure.confidence: confirmed_static; target decompilation and relocation-resolved call identities

conclusion: The final-letter probe reaches mask 0x7F and performs normal effect/removal. The real outer-state consumer requires DS:89E6 != 0; the focused Ghidra closure proves that 4EAA enters a DS:5044-selected timed wait before calling 14E1, and the extended native cloud trace reaches both the wait and the completion consumer with the complete mask and exit sentinel. The all-seven comparator, presentation, selector handoff, and reload gates are statically closed; the authored input-wait release, natural return from the completion routine, and later resource/reload state remain runtime boundaries.
